opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based music creators (songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers or performers who write their own music) of all genres and backgrounds at different career stages
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career with grants of up to £5,000 for the creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers. Activities eligible for support include recording, touring and marketing.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists, bands and performers writing their own music based in Liverpool City Region, as well as future industry professionals based in Liverpool City Region
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting outstanding artists and bands outside London who face additional barriers in reaching a crucial career tipping point based on their location. Provides financial support of up to £5k.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists, bands and performers writing their own music based in Tees Valley, as well as future industry professionals based in Tees Valley
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting outstanding artists and bands outside London who face additional barriers in reaching a crucial career tipping point based on their location. Provides financial support of up to £5k.

opportunities.title: Women Make Music
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non binary songwriters, composers, artists, bands and performers who are writing their own music
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds. There will be one bumper deadline in the second half of 2026 (date TBC).

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been invited to perform or create new music at international industry facing showcasing festivals, song writing camps or conferences
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based music creators who have been formally invited to participate in international industry-facing events. Rolling deadlines.

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record who are already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK and have potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas
opportunities.summary: Gives composers with a strong track record direct access to funding at pivotal stages in their career. Supports up to 15 composers per year who can make the case for support enabling a significant step change in their career.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres
opportunities.summary: Offers an opportunity for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production with grants of between £5,000 and £10,000.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Emerging/early career independent promoters in England
opportunities.summary: Recognises the vital role independent promoters play in supporting the talent pipeline across England, offering grant funding and capacity building support for booking, programming and promotion of gigs, concerts, club nights, shows, tours and other performances. Grants of up to £3,500.

opportunities.title: Resonate
opportunities.summary: Fund and resource encouraging professional orchestras to programme into their repertoire the best pieces of British music from the past 25 years. Financial support with grants of up to £10k to orchestras who commit to exploring contemporary UK repertoire.
